name: star
description: Represents favoriting, rating, or celebrating. On hover the star squashes in anticipation, bursts with a twist, and settles while three sparkles break off in different directions.

provenance.notes: Base star path picked from a third-party icon site by the maintainer and animated via Gemini; exact source site unconfirmed (1024x1024 grid suggests Ant Design Icons, MIT — UNVERIFIED, confirm before use). License status: pending human review — confirm the source site before promoting to stable. Documented intentional 1024x1024 viewBox deviation to preserve the contributed geometry exactly.

animation.description: The star squashes (scale 0.75, rotate -15deg), bursts (scale 1.15, rotate 18deg), and settles (0.65s easeInOut) about its center. Three 4-point sparkles break from the center in staggered directions (top-right, top-left, bottom-right; 0.55-0.65s easeOut), scaling and spinning as they fade. One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context for what is being favorited when used in a button.
